title: mlflow agent setup coding-agent prompt: edit the tracing checklist in build_agent_prompt and pin section order in the setup shell tests
answers: Where is the instruction text that the coding agent receives from mlflow agent setup generated?
How do I change what the agent is told to do before or after instrumenting an app in the setup wizard?
Why does a test fail on the order of '## N.' headings in the agent setup prompt?
Where is the 'Verify tracing with a realistic input' guidance handled?
body:
Path: mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh:build_agent_prompt assembles the prompt the setup wizard hands to the coding agent for tracing setup, for every backend (databricks, remote, local), by printf-ing a list of lines; the backend case block inserts configuration text between the header and the instrumentation steps.
Rule: The guidance is an ordered numbered checklist ("## 1. Understand the application" through "## 7. Report results") emitted by build_agent_prompt; to change agent behavior, edit those lines in setup.sh, and keep the headings in sequence because tests/agent/test_setup_sh_unit.py:test_build_agent_prompt_requires_repo_summary_and_realistic_trace_input asserts each heading's index in stdout is increasing.
Constraints: Applies to the text the agent receives, not to the tracing APIs or the shared instrumentation skill; the prompt output is checked with run_shell and substring assertions, so renaming a phrase requires updating that test.
Applies: Any change to the instructions mlflow agent setup gives a coding agent for tracing setup (setup.sh prompt text and its shell unit test).
applies: Edits to the coding-agent tracing prompt generated by mlflow agent setup (setup.sh build_agent_prompt and its unit test).
says: Update the step-by-step tracing checklist provided to the coding agent during setup.
Automated setup tests fail because numbered section headings in the wizard prompt are misordered.
Change the setup wizard instructions so the agent verifies tracing using realistic sample data.
Customize the instrumentation checklist shown to the agent across local, remote, and cloud backends.
Rearrange the onboarding guidance steps given to automated coding assistants configuring telemetry.
search: The coding-agent tracing instructions generated by mlflow agent setup are assembled as a numbered checklist in setup.sh within build_agent_prompt. Headings from '## 1. Understand the application' through '## 7. Report results' must maintain strictly increasing sequential order to satisfy test_build_agent_prompt_requires_repo_summary_and_realistic_trace_input. Backend case blocks insert configuration lines between the header and instrumentation steps for databricks, remote, and local backends. This applies solely to prompt text emitted to the agent, where modifying phrases requires updating shell unit tests using run_shell.
